section_summary.extract_value: This section describes use of the 23-item Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2), administered nightly to assess participants' intuitive eating with items rated 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). It reports good internal consistency in the current study (Cronbach's alphas .87 to .90 across days) and an average IES-2 score over the week of 3.48 (SD = 0.48). No sample characteristics, BMI assessment, body appreciation measures, or correlations with BMI are reported in this section.
